title: Randomized value of the predicate
statement:
Let $\mu_0,\mu_1,\mu_2\in[-1,1]$ be the means of three independent random signs supplied to the predicate. Its randomized acceptance probability is
\[
\frac34-\frac{\mu_0}{4}-\frac{\mu_1\mu_2}{4}-\frac{\mu_0\mu_1\mu_2}{4}.
\]
